name: Franklin Industries Limited
about: Franklin Industries Limited engages in the agricultural activities in India. The company also distributes and trades in agricultural products; and cultivates cucumber, onion, and castor products. It also provides contract farming services. The company was formerly known as Murad Properties & Projects Limited and changed its name to Franklin Industries Limited in April 2017. Franklin Industries Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
